subject: Retention tiers & tracing: packaging and enterprise discount ask
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@sovereignhealth.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sovereignhealth.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@sovereignhealth.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Question on retention & tracing add-on pricing

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Sovereign Health is excited about Redwood's latency and fallback features. Before we move to procurement, our legal and infra teams want clarity on two things: retention tiers for observability (how long traces/logs are kept at each price point) and how tracing ingest is priced (per-span, per-request, or sampling-based). Also, are advanced dashboards sold separately or bundled with retention?

We expect to onboard ~12 services during pilot with peak 300 rps and would like pricing that scales if we go to ~1000 rps in year 1. Is there a bulk-discount for multiple add-ons if we commit to a 24-month agreement?

Appreciate a short summary we can include in our procurement packet.

Best,
Claire
Claire Nguyen
Head of Infrastructure, Sovereign Health

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@sovereignhealth.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question on retention & tracing add-on pricing

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below; attaching a short pricing one-pager and draft SOW for procurement. I kept it concise for your packet.

- Retention tiers: 30d / 90d / 365d. Pricing is by GB retained/month with volume breaks at 1TB, 5TB, 20TB.
- Tracing ingest: billed on sampled spans ingested (we recommend 10% default sampling at pilot). We can also offer per-request pricing for strict accuracy, but that is typically higher.
- Advanced dashboards: can be purchased as an add-on (flat monthly seat + dashboard bundle) or included at a discounted rate when you commit to the 365d retention tier.

For a 24-month committed term we typically offer a 10–18% add-on bundling discount depending on committed volume and whether you also take Dedicated capacity. If Sovereign can commit to an annualized baseline (e.g., 6TB/month avg retained), we can push to the upper end of that range.

I recommend we set a short call tomorrow to lock numbers for procurement and agree on optional DocuSign deliverables. Marcus, can you confirm the sampling guidance and any quota/ingest caveats?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0183

Attachments: Redwood_Observability_Pricing_20261115.pdf; SOW_SovereignHealth_Draft_20261116.docx

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@sovereignhealth.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question on retention & tracing add-on pricing

Claire — quick technical note:

- Sampling: default 10% should keep cost predictable and still capture SLO-impacting traces. If you have request types that need full fidelity, we support per-endpoint overrides.
- Ingest spikes: we apply short-term smoothing and quota guards; overage is billed at 1.5x baseline rate unless covered by committed burst capacity.
- Retention sizing: the attached pricing sheet has the GB/month to storage mapping; for 12 services at 300 rps with 10% sampling we estimate ~0.8–1.2 TB/month retained at 30d retention.

Happy to walk the infra team through sampling rules — I can do a 30-min session Thursday.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@sovereignhealth.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sovereignhealth.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@sovereignhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question on retention & tracing add-on pricing

Vanessa, Marcus —

Thanks, that helps. A few follow-ups from procurement:
- Can we get an example invoice line for the 365d bundle with the dashboards included? (We need to show line items in our cost model.)
- For discounts: Sovereign is asking if Redwood will do 20% off add-ons if we commit to a 24-month term and a 12TB/month baseline (we would take the 365d retention + tracing + advanced dashboards). Is 20% possible if we also sign up for annual reserved capacity?
- Any SLA implication for longer retention (e.g., restore windows, export/exportability)?

If you can reply with a redlined number sheet we can put in the packet, procurement can expedite.

Claire

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@sovereignhealth.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question on retention & tracing add-on pricing

Claire — looping in pricing ops notes and an example invoice structure. Quick bullets:

- Invoice example (monthly):
  1) Observability retention (365d) — baseline 12TB/mo @ $X/GB = $YYY
  2) Tracing ingest (sampled spans) — included in retention pricing up to N spans/month; excess at $Z per million spans
  3) Advanced dashboards — $AA per seat/mo + $BB per dashboard bundle (or included at $0 with 365d + 24mo commit and annual reserved capacity)

- Discounting: 20% total off add-on list-prices is reachable if: 1) 24-month term; 2) minimum annualized committed spend of $XXXk; and 3) 1-year notice on predicted ramp (so we can capacity-plan). If you commit to Dedicated reserved capacity with annual commit we can shift to a blended 22–25% effective discount (because infra discounts stack).

- SLA: retention increases do not change our read/write SLA for telemetry. For export/restore on long-retention buckets we offer a 72-hour standard restore window in the SOW; expedited restores (24h) available as an add-on.

I attached an example invoice snippet in the SOW draft. Vanessa, happy for you to share the redline/proposed numbers.

— Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Pricing Operations
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@sovereignhealth.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@sovereignhealth.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question on retention & tracing add-on pricing

Claire —

Attached is a redline proposal that maps to your asks. Short summary of the concession:
- 20% off add-on list-prices for the 24-month term at 12TB/month baseline (confirmed).
- If you add annual Dedicated reserved capacity we move to a 23% blended add-on discount and include Advanced Dashboards at no additional per-seat cost for up to 15 seats.
- Restore window: standard 72h; expedited restores available at $3k per incident (SOW contains the exact language).

Next step: If that works, I can send the DocuSign with the SOW + Order Form and Procurement can countersign. Would you like the DocuSign in the name of Sovereign Health or Sovereign Health, Inc.?

Best,
Vanessa
